severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — COMMERCE INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: SYNTHETIC-REVIEW FRONT SATURATES COMMERCE REGIONS AS AI-GENERATED FIVE-STAR TESTIMONIALS PRAISE PRODUCTS THE REVIEWER NEVER TOUCHED, IN A KITCHEN THAT WAS NEVER BUILT, FOR A PROBLEM NO ONE EVER HAD
advisory: The National Slop Service has issued a Heavy Slop Warning for all commerce regions through Saturday evening. A dense front of synthetic product reviews is depositing uniform five-star praise across listings at a rate exceeding the number of units ever sold. Residents are advised that a review reading 'this product solved all my problems and arrived promptly' may describe a product that does not function, did not arrive, and in several documented cases, does not exist. The Service reminds the public that a star rating is a number, and numbers, like the rest of us, can be synthesized.

regional_outlook.conditions: Heavy testimonial accumulation around newly published apps, many posted minutes after launch by accounts with no prior activity and suspiciously grateful dispositions. Expect a glossy five-star haze obscuring the one-star reviews that actually describe the app.

Scattered banks of 'handmade with love' praise settling over mass-dropshipped inventory. Residents should note when a hundred glowing reviews all mention the same vague 'quality craftsmanship' without describing a single object.
Thick 'Best 7 [Product]s of 2026 — We Tested Them All' fog, generated by sites that have tested nothing and held nothing. Visibility of genuine comparison reduced to near zero.
Gusty reply-guy testimonial activity beneath product posts, with identical phrasing drifting between unrelated accounts. Astroturf advisory remains in effect.
'We'd love your honest review!' solicitations arriving in pre-filled five-star form, requiring only a click. Honesty optional and increasingly discouraged.

specimen.status: Hyper-abundant; breeding year-round wherever a star rating can be affixed.
specimen.habitat: Review sections, comparison listicles, and the grateful underbelly of any product page.
specimen.field_marks: Uniform plumage of superlatives; no specific details; a backstory arc from 'skeptical at first' to 'changed my life' compressed into forty words. Often reports prompt arrival of items that have not shipped.
specimen.call: I was hesitant at first, but WOW — this exceeded all my expectations and solved a problem I didn't even know I had. Fast shipping, great quality, highly recommend to anyone! Will definitely buy again.
specimen.confusion_species: The Genuinely Satisfied Customer, which it closely mimics. Distinguish by specificity: a real reviewer mentions the odd thing that went wrong, the color that was slightly off, the size that ran small. The Phantom is seamless, and seamlessness is the tell.

spotter_tip: Sort by one star before you believe the five. The honest weather lives in the basement of the ratings, where the people who actually used the thing tend to gather.
tomorrow: Synthetic-review front persists; a developing testimonial surge expected as holiday-shopping pressure builds upstream.
